# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Publish reviewed CPU-only receipt plumbing and research after run closure."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('capture_adapter_publish_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(hashes(value), indent=2) + '\n')


def archive(path, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    checks = [B / f'main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review-root-v{i}/record.json' for i in (1, 2)]
    data = [load(path) for path in checks]
    assert all(not row['active'] and all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in row['commands']) for row in data)
    assert not data[0]['passed'] and data[1]['passed'] and data[1]['complete']
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in data[1]['source_pins'].items())
    env = data[1]['environment']
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_capture_qualified=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED ADAPTER PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800, rss_cap=2 << 30,
                            text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=16 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '010909772b621c71f1c635b4e1ccc37b36afbe4f'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        F.mkdir()
        for path in checks:
            dump(F / 'receipts' / (path.parent.name + '.json'), load(path))
        for name in ('main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review-v2.py', 'main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        names = ['implementation-fixed-history-production-receipt-adapter-v1.txt',
                 'research-phase-stock-supervisor-admission-round372-v1.txt',
                 'research-phase-stock-supervisor-admission-round372-v2.txt',
                 'research-prefill-only-copy-queue-selection-round373-v1.txt',
                 'research-prefill-only-copy-queue-selection-round373-v2.txt']
        pins = []
        for name in names:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013/bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-cache-runtime-admission/report-registry-v186.json'
        count = load(previous)['research_completed'] + len(pins)
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v187.json', dict(research_completed=count, prior=dict(path=str(previous),
            git_revision='54385d6f975a13df5da87f489614d0b729d2aba6', sha256=m.sha(previous)), new_reports=pins))
        dump(F / 'summary.json', dict(main_reviewed=True, source_pins=data[1]['source_pins'],
            new_adapter_schema_tests=9, existing_comparator_tests=11, new_source_lints_passed=True,
            first_lint_failed_status_retained=True, source_only_runtime=False, cpu_checks_executed=True,
            gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_capture_qualified=False,
            persistent_state_qualified=False, quality_qualified=False, adopted=False,
            benchmark_method='Unchanged pristine upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3', performance_samples_added=False,
            research_registry_count=count, main_errata=[
                'R372v1 incorrectly required explicit ckpt0 despite the implemented observed-fresh-state omission admission; corrected v2 is authoritative.',
                'R373v1 mislabeled TPS as ms and reversed the improvement direction. V2 fixes units/direction and finds existing native copy stream is already prefill-only.',
                'Native queue selection and unchanged decode CPU guard overhead are separate questions; no new selector is implemented.',
                'Actual raw spec4/noMTP/suffix0 yields effective verifier T1; raw spec0 is not the stock measured argv.'],
            next_step='Main actual production capture/controller and persistent state validation; phase model admission with new pinned source/config and unchanged stock benchmark'))
        ja = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Fixed-history capture receipt の CPU 検査

同じ履歴からの full-vocabulary FP32 logits を比較する既存の道具に、capture の
出所と終了状態を照合する companion を追加しました。owner の終了・reap、
source・command・環境・provider の同一性、全行の寸法と有限値を検査します。
不完全な capture を合格にせず、生成文の完全一致を品質の条件にしません。

Main が新規 schema／異常入力 9 テストと既存 comparator 11 テストを実行し、
通りました。新規ファイルの全 lint も通りました。初回 lint の型注釈と改行の
指摘を修正し、初回の失敗記録を保存しています。モデルや GPU は実行していません。
実 producer の登録は空のままで、production と品質の認定値は false です。
実 capture、GDN/QSA/PLE 状態の RESTORE 比較、held-out 品質は unverified です。

並行調査の修正版は、stock client の ckpt 省略が実際の fresh state と容量 0 の
条件で受容できることと、既存 native copy stream の production 呼び出し先が
既に prefill だけであることを確認しました。decode の queue が generic であることと、
共通 CPU guard の負荷まで同一であることを区別します。追加 selector は実装しません。
速度の比較には引き続き変更していない上流 bench.sh を使います。

元の報告と修正版、実行 command と環境、失敗・成功の結果は registry と receipts に
保存しています。閉じた CPU 検査の重複ログだけを照合後に削除し、pinned receipt は
そのまま保持します。次は Main 管理の実モデル phase 確認と production capture です。
'''
        en = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Fixed-history capture receipt CPU checks

A companion validates provenance and closure for full-vocabulary FP32 logits
from the same history. It checks owner exit/reap, source/command/environment/
provider identity, exact row geometry and finite values. Incomplete captures
fail. Exact generated prose is not a quality requirement.

Main ran nine new schema/negative-input tests and eleven existing comparator
tests; all passed. All new-file lints passed after fixing annotation and wrapping
findings. The original failed lint outcome is retained. No model or GPU ran.
The real producer registry remains empty, with production and quality flags
false. Actual captures, GDN/QSA/PLE RESTORE comparisons and held-out quality are
unverified.

Corrected research confirms that stock ckpt omission is accepted with actual
fresh state and zero cache capacity, and that the existing native copy stream
already has only a prefill production caller. Generic decode queue selection
does not prove identical shared CPU guard overhead. No extra selector is added.
Performance comparisons continue through unchanged upstream bench.sh.

Original and corrected reports, commands/environment and failed/successful
checks are in the registry and receipts. Closed CPU-check duplicate logs retire
only after verification; pinned receipts remain unchanged. Next are Main-owned
phase model admission and actual production capture.
'''
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        deletions = []
        for path, row in zip(checks, data):
            for raw in sorted((path.parent / 'commands').glob('*')):
                if raw.suffix in ('.stdout', '.stderr') and raw.is_file():
                    assert raw.read_text() == row['evidence'][raw.stem][raw.suffix[1:]]
                    deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(raw),
                        reason='Closed CPU check output represented exactly in unchanged pinned receipt and committed derivative'))
        retention = dict(deletions=deletions, deleted=False, owner='Main', active_runs_touched=False,
                         original_pinned_receipts_retained=True, byte_budget=2 << 20,
                         consumer='Actual producer adapter/collector qualification', next_review='After real capture and state comparison',
                         free_space_claim=False)
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        files = [str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()]
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in data[1]['source_pins'].items())
        for entry in deletions:
            assert m.sha(entry['path']) == entry['sha256']
        for entry in deletions:
            Path(entry['path']).unlink()
        retention.update(deleted=True, removed_file_count=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletions))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *data[1]['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'test(quality): validate closed fixed-history capture receipt schema'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_registry_count=count, removed_files=len(deletions),
                 removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'research_registry_count', 'removed_files')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
